description: This file contains the PHP class 'Tracking' which is part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It belongs to the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Account' and handles customer tracking functionalities such as viewing tracking info, redirecting customers based on session tokens, and auxiliary features like autocomplete for search suggestions. The class extends a core Controller class and defines at least two main methods: index() for rendering the tracking page and autocomplete() for providing search tracking suggestions via JSON.

classes.name: Tracking
classes.description: Controller class managing customer account tracking functionalities, including rendering the tracking page and providing autocomplete search suggestions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the account tracking page, managing session validation, breadcrumb setup, loading models and language, and rendering the view.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides JSON response for search autocomplete, including tracking parameter validation and search results retrieval based on the query.
